Joel Jackson used the Manus agent to convert a spreadsheet directly into a Meta ads account through a native integration.

Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Joel Jackson used the Manus agent for spreadsheet to ads account in Meta. The agent performed the conversion directly because of its native integration with Meta. No access details, steps taken by the agent, or human interventions are described.
How it went
The post states no results, numbers, or shortcomings.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
I have a spreadsheet at [link or attached file] with columns for [campaign name, audience, budget, ad copy, image or link, etc.]. Turn each row into a Meta ads campaign draft in my ad account [account name], mapping the columns sensibly. Before creating or activating anything that could spend money, pause and show me a summary table of every campaign, budget, and audience so I can approve it.
